headline: Is Medtronic’s Cannula Recall and CoreMap Investment Altering The Investment Case For Medtronic (MDT)?
summary: In late July 2026, Medtronic voluntarily initiated a Class II recall of specific lots of its DLP One-Piece Pediatric Arterial Cannula after two complaints revealed loose foreign material with trace blood, affecting worldwide distribution including several U.S. states. Around the same time, Medtronic led a US$37.00 million Series C funding round for CoreMap to advance electrophysiology mapping for atrial fibrillation, underscoring how quality-control setbacks can coexist with efforts to...
